items.title: Johnny Lala Interview, 1960-03-15
items.q: Yellow, Tony Sbarba, Eddie Edwards, he's dead now, the countercrap.

ctx.x: No. Yellow was recorded without Nick. Yellow was recorded with the band of this planet. He was in Louisiana 5. I said Yellow. He was in Louisiana 5. And then Nick came after them. They had a man up there before the rocker, Johnny.
Yellow, Tony Sbarba, Eddie Edwards, he's dead now, the countercrap. Eddie Edwards. Eddie Edwards. Eddie Edwards. Eddie Edwards was a Trombor. The Trombor. Eddie Edwards.
Eddie Edwards was still alive in New York.
